run_keypoints2coco: run the script to convert pose keypoints from a JSON file with bboxes to COCO annotation format
run_init_pose_model: run init_pose_model to build a pose estimation model from a config and checkpoint file
run_inference_top_down_pose_model: run inference_top_down_pose_model to predict keypoints on images using person bounding boxes
run_coco_loadImgs: run COCO loadImgs to load image metadata by image ID from a COCO JSON file
run_coco_getAnnIds: run COCO getAnnIds to retrieve annotation IDs for a given image ID
